function.name: patch
function.description: Apply several unique text replacements to one existing UTF-8 file in one step. Hunks are applied in order; each old_text must occur exactly once at the time it is applied. All-or-nothing: the file is untouched if any hunk fails. Prefer edit for a single fragment and write for a full rewrite.

path.description: File path relative to the workspace root.

old_text.description: Exact existing text to replace. Must occur exactly once.
